text: This report requests Etobicoke York Community Council approval to rename the Centennial Recreation Centre West as "The New Generation Youth Recreation Centre". This proposed name better reflects the centre's function as a youth-focused recreation facility. Property naming and renaming are a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The report outlines the renaming process taken by Parks, Forestry and Recreation which followed the City of Toronto Property Naming Policy including the required public and local Councillor engagement and consultation. The top three names voted on by youth included: The Base Youth Recreation Centre, The New Generation Youth Recreation Centre, and Centre 6 Youth Recreation Centre. Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Adopted the renaming of the Centennial Recreation Centre West located at 2694 Eglinton Avenue to "The New Generation Youth Recreation Centre".
